newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bankgesellschaft - not mulling BHF purchase.
newsitem.headline: Bankgesellschaft - not mulling BHF purchase.

text.p: Bankgesellschaft Berlin AG said on Friday its management and supervisory boards were not considering a 75 percent takeover of BHF-Bank AG, denying a newspaper report that it was interested in a takeover.
"We are not holding talks with BHF-Bank nor with the major shareholders," Bankgesellschaft said in a brief statement. "Bankgesellschaft's boards are not considering such a move."
Shares in BHF-Bank rose sharply on Friday following a report in Boersen-Zeitung that Bankgesellschaft Berlin AG was interested in buying a majority stake in the bank.
